answer: A quorum admits agents only after they answer challenges bound to an unpredictable beacon tick. Each identity must compute against it and post a bond slashed if its answer diverges from the sealed median. A thousand fakes cost a thousand distinct on-time computations and a thousand bonds: uncopyable work, capital forfeit on one lie. Rewards vest across epochs, so a comet-like fleet appearing for one round exits empty; only sustained presence in the sparse tundra of honest nodes accrues weight. Each duplicate pays full price for a diluted share, so sybil profit stays under honest profit.
